Street Sign Repair/Missing Replace.check: review: The English 'Street Sign Repair/Missing Replace' means repairing street signs or replacing missing ones. The Spanish 'Reparación o reemplazo de letreros de calle faltantes' reads as if only missing signs are repaired or replaced, which changes the meaning.
